text:
jess_sales: Hey team — Acme just dropped a SIG/CAIQ + custom security questionnaire on the deal (attached). Need security review + answers by EOD Friday if possible. Also customer is asking if we can run the POC in their VPC or if dedicated is required. 

anya_security: Got it. Can you drop the file here or give a link? I need to triage scope (high-level infra/data questions vs legal/contract asks). Also who is the SOC audit contact for them?

jess_sales: Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1AcmeSIGCAIQ (internal share). SOC contact is "security@acme.com" per the SOW. POC timeline: they want to start next week. Pricing note: they asked for a discounted POC + extended logs retention for 30 days.

carlos_se: For the POC, we need to confirm whether they want Redwood Private (VPC/on-prem) or if Dedicated with private subnets is enough. If they're sending production-like data, Private is recommended. If it's synthetic/test data, Hosted/Dedicated could work.

anya_security: Downloading now. Initial ask: assign owner, create vendor risk ticket. I'm going to create a ticket in our VRT queue and map SIG sections to our control templates. 

mike_support: FYI we have a canned answers sheet for common SIG/CAIQ questions in GDrive: https://drive.google.com/answers/sig-template. It covers encryption at rest/in transit, key management, incident response contacts. Use it as a starting point.

anya_security: @jess_sales can you confirm whether Acme will send any customer PII during the POC? That changes data classification and controls.

jess_sales: They said PII is not needed for the POC — they'll use synthetic data. I'll get that in writing.

anya_security: OK. Creating ticket now. Ticket fields:
- Summary: "Acme SIG/CAIQ intake for POC — attach questionnaire"
- Assignee: anya_security
- Due: 2025-11-14 (EOD)

sec-bot: Created ticket VR-2025-342 in #sec-queue and assigned to anya_security. https://our-issues.internal/VR-2025-342

carlos_se: I'll take the POC infra design once the security baseline is approved. Quick checklist for me: networking model (VPC vs dedicated), egress controls, KMS integration, data retention rules. Also need to confirm whether they require HSM.

jess_sales: @carlos_se please capture any pricing delta for Private vs Dedicated and share with me — they asked about discounts but we need numbers.

mike_support: For the questionnaire answers, recommend redacting anything contractual and pushing MSA/legal Qs to legal. Security can answer technical controls.

anya_security: Agreed. I'll answer technical controls and flag items for legal (e.g., indemnity, data residency clauses). Also will request SSAE/SOC2 report and their vendor posture documents.

jess_sales: Thx. Can we get an ETA on the security answers? We need to send initial responses to Acme by Friday morning to keep the POC timeline.

anya_security: I'll aim for a first-pass tomorrow afternoon. Finalized answers by Thursday EOD if no major gaps. If anything blocker-level appears, I'll escalate.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Acme security sync" tomorrow 09:00 PT with attendees anya_security, carlos_se, jess_sales.

carlos_se: One more thing — for the POC we might need temporary elevated throughput. Who owns capacity approvals for Dedicated bursts?

jess_sales: I'll loop in ops if we need burst capacity; sales can sign off on short-term uplift for POC.

anya_security: Logging/retention request: Acme asked for 30d retention. That's non-default for Hosted. I'll note it as a requirement and include operational implications in VR-2025-342.

mike_support: Also adding the canned answer for "log retention" to the ticket: 
```
We can configure log retention up to 90 days on Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, retention beyond 7 days requires an add-on. Logs are encrypted at rest and access is role-based.
```
jess_sales: Perfect. I'll send Acme a quick ack: "Received, security triage in progress, expect initial answers by tomorrow."

anya_security: If anyone gets docs directly from Acme (SLA, SOC, config specs), paste them in the ticket. I'll run SIG mapping and post the control gaps + recommended mitigations.

jess_sales: Assigned to VR-2025-342. Thanks all — will update the customer after your first-pass. :thumbsup:
